Abstract. Agricultural drought threatens rainfed rice production in Nigeria, where smallholder farmers depend on rainfall and have limited capacity to buffer climate shocks. While meteorological drought indices such as the SPI and the SPEI are widely used in national early warning systems, their ability to capture the impacts of droughts on rainfed rice yields at the smallholder field-level remains uncertain.

In the context of this study, “deceptive communication” includes mis- and disinformation (also notated as mis/disinformation), propaganda, fake news, and conspiracy theories. Background and Aims Forest road networks are a prerequisite for sustainable forest management. Despite sustained investment since the 1960s, no continuous national series has distinguished between the road categories reported in Turkish official statistics. This study compiles such a series for 1998–2025, establishes which categories can defensibly be counted as network additions, and interprets the resulting density values against international benchmarks and harvesting system requirements.

Abstract Effective implementation of school-based health program depends on successful pre-implementation, which may influence program adoption, delivery, and outcomes. Despite its importance, pre-implementation remains underexplored. The Generation Healthy kids (GHK) study examined factors influencing pre-implementation of a multicomponent health promotion program in Danish primary schools from a school management perspective using the Consolidated Framework for Implementation Research (CFIR).

abstract: Landmines remain a significant threat in many regions recovering from conflict, causing injuries, loss of life, and slowing down economic and social progress. This project presents the development of an autonomous robotic system designed to detect landmines while improving the safety and efficiency of detection activities. The system uses a mobile robot equipped with sensors such as a metal detector and ultrasonic sensors to locate possible landmines as it moves through hazardous areas without requiring direct human control.

This study investigates the relationship between students’ physical activities outside the classroom and their engagement during lessons in Grade IV at SDN Mluweh 01, Ungaran Timur District, Semarang Regency. AbstractBackgroundGlobal estimates are esssential for tracking international targets such as the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), therefore vital for planning and priority setting. Modelling and estimation of health indicators vary greatly in aspects of methodology, assumptions, data sources, data quality, and data availability. To aid with consistent reporting of global estimates, a reporting guideline; The Guidance for Accurate and Transparent Health Estimates Reporting (GATHER) was developed in 2016.

This paper deals with the fiscal cost of climate induced urban flooding. A hedonic analysis of the sales price of around 900 residential properties, transacted from 2015 to 2019, reveals that flood risk lowers the mean sales price of residential homes by a margin of 12.6% to 15%. An analysis of officially defined zonal Annual Statement Rates (ASR), which is the common revenue base for two important taxes levied by state and local Government, is analysed for around 735 revenue zones of Greater Mumbai for the period 2003 to 2023.
